messages:
maya: Quick thread to lock down the benchmark narrative for launch. need one hero chart direction, a short hero line that avoids pricing lists, and two CTA flows for inbound.

devin: paste the mock numbers and i'll normalize to an index so we don't publish raw prices. also will add a p95 inset.

maya: mock data for design comps: 
```
model,median_ms,p95_ms,cost_per_1k
Redwood-Prod,110,240,0.10
OpenEdge,260,900,0.04
QuantLite,175,320,0.07
```

harper: two visual options: 1) throughput-per-$ bar (tokens per $) with tiny p95 sparkline; 2) latency vs cost scatter with quadrants. i prefer #1 as hero for landing.

nate: agree on #1 for hero (buyers grasp "tokens per $" quickly). save scatter for "how we measured" deep dive. important: call out tail (p95/p99) in the subhead.

riley: inbound routing split: PLG dev -> "Start in 5 minutes" (self-serve), Platform/SRE -> "Request architecture review" (form + AE). webinar CTA should be separate: "See the full methodology" -> webinar signup.

devin: recommendation: index Redwood=1.0, show % delta vs Redwood in tooltip. add footnote: "Synthetic workload, batching & KV cache enabled; see appendix." avoids hard price claims.

maya: hero lines to test: A) "Predictable token economics for production" B) "Lower $/token, tighter tail latency" which to A/B?

harper: A for landing, B for webinar creative. B is punchy but reads like a claim.

nate: also add downloadable PNG + CSV on the page for transparency. marketing ops: tag downloads to lead source so we can route.

ops-bot: Task created: https://app.shortcut.com/redwood-inference/story/bench-launch-1789009999 (assignees: devin, harper, riley, nate)

maya: action items: devin -> normalized index + p95 inset (Weds EOD); harper -> hero + deep-dive mockups (Thurs AM); riley -> CTA copy + routing flows (Thurs); nate -> one-paragraph methodology & AE qualification script. reconvene Fri morning to pick hero. thanks all :raised_hands:
